about.title: Bhutan Taekwondo Federation
about.subtitle: The official national governing body of Taekwondo sport in the Kingdom of Bhutan.
about.visionDesc: To educate and guide Bhutanese youth through the core tenets of Taekwondo (Courtesy, Integrity, Perseverance, Self-Control, Indomitable Spirit), building physical fitness alongside leadership and moral character.
about.historyStep1: Official establishment of Bhutan Taekwondo Federation (BTF) and approval as an ATU member
about.historyStep2: Affiliation as a regular member of the Bhutan Olympic Committee (BOC)
about.historyStep3: Integration of Taekwondo into co-curricular activities across national schools
about.historyStep4: Partnership agreement signed for the KOICA Youth Development ODA Project

project.title: Youth Capacity Building Project
project.subtitle: An official ODA project focused on youth education and infrastructure in partnership with KOICA.
project.overviewDesc: Supported by the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), this ODA project aims to foster the capacity of Bhutanese youth by integrating physical training (Taekwondo) with global health education and core value alignment.
project.centerDesc: Under construction in Thimphu, the Iconic Center serves as the primary hub for multi-purpose youth sports and educational training.

taekwondo.desc: Regular dispatch of certified masters to schools and centers across Bhutan, offering free training and belt grading certification.

defaultNotices.title: Success of the 2nd Ambassador Cup Taekwondo Championship
defaultNotices.content: Hosted by the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Bangladesh, the championship concluded successfully in Thimphu with over 300 athletes showcasing spectacular skills.

defaultNotices.title: Schedule Announcement for Fall Integrated Belt Grading
defaultNotices.content: Official belt promotion tests will be conducted sequentially across 9 target zones from October. Regional masters, please submit application forms on time.

defaultNotices.title: Construction Framework Completion for Thimphu Iconic Center (65% Progress)
defaultNotices.content: The structural concrete work for the multi-purpose youth center has completed. The project remains on schedule for its official grand opening in late 2026.
